## AccountUpdateInput.emptyTrashOnQuit property

Indicates whether the messages in deleted messages mailboxes will be permanently deleted on quit. Cannot be reset: null is rejected.

**Signature:**

```typescript
emptyTrashOnQuit?: boolean;
```
